kaviedes: the player in yellow jumps and heads the ball powerfully toward the goal, the goalkeeper in green dives and stretches but cannot reach it
centro: the long-haired player in yellow kicks a curved cross with his left foot, the ball flies away in an arc, the crowd stands up
gol: the ball hits the back of the net and the net shakes, the goalkeeper falls to the grass, the player in yellow turns to celebrate
festejo: the player in yellow runs and celebrates with open arms shouting, confetti falls, the crowd jumps and waves flags
